text: The main question must be: what was the design of the exercise at the Auora shore? What was the plan, mechanics, objective, instructions, and how were the players placed in formation?  The exercise was to test how they will react and survive to a near or simulated drowning. How to save your teammates, in water, (and by extension, in court). That's why non-swimmers were intermixed with non swimmers. This was not for physical conditioning, but for "mental toughness". How do you test mental toughness in water (Aurora is a known  for its big waves; they have done this there before). The biggest threat of open water is drowning. The way to survive as was the mental toughness of  relying on the help of your teammates, devising a teamwork given the dire circumtances. When everyone survives, the lesson of saving, helping and collaborating with teammates is achieved. A band of brothers is formed, having faced and survived a near death experience, the bond is strong. Players in the past have nearly drowned. (That was as "successful" exercise for "mental toughness" and forming an esprit de corps that arises from military bootchamps. But they went back there. These are young men willing and desperate to improve themselves under the authoritative direction of coaches who have brought the team to championship. ("We will do anything".) This brutal exercise is a form of collective violence (sociologists call this violentization, horrorification, brutalization, and violence coaching. "You have saved each other in the past, you can rely on each other now, and save each other in the court."

THIS MAKES SENSE. After watching the interviews of Sam and Kieffer, and the other three team members - Jared, Ian and Andrew, and the resurfaced podcast featuring former student-athletes, this is a compelling analysis.

Sam mentioned that they were briefed about ""rip currents" and what to do in such situations days before the training. Coach Baldwin also mentioned to them that the purpose is to build bond, get closer and develop that "mental toughness".

Based on the resort owner's statement, he reportedly informed Coach Baldwin about the rip currents and the associated dangers as early as 2016. Despite this, they still proceeded with the activity.

So mapapaisip ka nalang talaga - how much of it was intentional?  Since they've been doing it for years, they may have viewed it as a manageable risk, believing they could rescue anyone who got into trouble in the water, just as they had in previous years. Pero nakakapagtaka lang din na, kung may muntik ng malunod dati, why weren't proper safety protocols put in place? Why risk the lives of these student-athletes?

Too bad, it ended this way. These kids are young and full of dreams. 😔
Gone too soon. Rest in eternal peace, Rene and Divine. 🕊🤍🙏

text:
Grabe kawawa lahat ng mga student athletes nato... Im watching their interview now. Ang negligent ng nagplano na mag watee activity sa open water na alam na palang may rip current ni Coach Tab Baldwin dun. So actually he risked all these athletes' lives. And totoo talaga pag may rip current pwede ka madala sa malayo and mag panic kahit marunong ka mag swim and kahit na galing ka lang sa mababaw. 

And a kwento ng mga bata nato, it's so obvious walang life guards nearby! 

Nakawitness nako ng ganito sa la union year 2022 holy week. Friday ata yun or saturday.  Nasa knee-deep lang yung mga taong tinangay ng current na around 3-5feet away from me lang. And seconds lang din nasa malayo na sila and bigla na lang ako nakarinig sigawan. Ako nasa mga ankle deep lang ako kasi yung waves pag nadating nalagpas ulo kahit nasa around 2 feet lang ako away from buhangin na walang water. Pero nararamdaman ko yung sand sa ilalim lumalalim parang naghihila yung water. Ayun may 5 tinangay. May mga surfer dun na may sirf board na sila yung nagsagip sa mga tao ang dami ng surfers pero even sila nag panic. Nakita ko yung isa na naligtas ang dami sinuka dami nainom water. And may isa hindi na nakita ilang oras na di pa din nakita yung 16yo. 

Grabe ang traumatic nun. Prior to that nag surfing lesson eme eme pa ako 1hour tinatangay din ako sa lagpas tao pero nakakabit sa paa ko surfboard pero nakakapanic pa din makabalik sa surf board kasi ang lakas alon. So sabi ko sa instructor ko ok nako naka 1 hour na din. Di ko pa alam nun na pwede matangay ng rip current. 

Kaya now trauma nako sa lahat ng beach . hanggang dun lang ako lagi sa konting nababasa lang paa ko lolz.

And locals sa la union told me madami talaga nalulinod dun di lang narereport. Then i told a friend na natangay din sya ng rio current sa baler naman mabuti naka attacj din sya sa surf board. At naligtas ng mga surfers. At sabi din sa kanya madami din daw nalulinod dun di lang nababalita.

Kaya wag nyo bully yung mga survivors. Survivor's guilt is real. Baka ano pa gawin ng mga bata na yan because of survivor's guilt. Bata pa yang mha yan 25yo and below hindi pa buo ang prefrontal cortex ng brain.
